messages:
Nora L.: Quick ping: PR #358 (migration-guide/legacy-auth) needs reviewers. Author is out until tomorrow. Target merge is Thu 14:00 UTC during the docs deploy. We need two reviewers and a sanity check on the example cURL output.

Felix T.: I can review the auth section and examples, but Im OOO after 12:00 UTC. If its urgent, assign before then.

Priya R.: On rotation today but juggling an incident. If you can get one reviewer assigned now Ill try to approve after 18:00 UTC. Who else can pick up?

Sam K.: I can do a quick style/formatting pass for code blocks. Im not the best for auth semantics. @Emily H. who usually owns auth migration content?

Emily H.: @Felix T. historically owned the auth migration details. If Felix is tied up after 12:00, can we get a second reviewer from platform docs? @Nora L. any volunteers?

Nora L.: I can do the second review focusing on CLI examples and redirect links. Note: I saw a failing link-check in the preview yesterday for anchor #token-flow. Might need an anchor rename.

Sam K.: Ran local preview just now, snippet failures: 
```
ERROR link-check: /guides/auth/legacy -> 404
WARN snippet-output-mismatch: examples/cli/auth.md line 33
```
Looks like the author changed the guide slug but not all links.

Felix T.: I can push a small fix for the slug and update the example output snapshot. Will do quick PR against the docs branch.

docs-bot: CI: Docs preview build queued for PR #358.

Priya R.: If Felix pushes the fix, I can re-run preview and review after my incident is stable. Nora and Sam are reviewers; Felix + Nora would give us two knowledgeable eyeballs.

Felix T.: Pushed commit fixing link and snapshot. Also trimmed an overly long code line into two lines for better wrapping. Triggering preview now.

docs-bot: CI: Build started for PR #358. Preview URL: https://docs-preview.redwood.com/pr/358/build/12

Sam K.: Preview looks much cleaner. One nit: CLI example shows a header "Authorization" instead of "Authorization: Bearer <token>" in the curl output block. Need explicit token demo for readability.

Nora L.: Agreed with Sam. Ill post an inline on the PR asking author to update the output. Small change, should be quick.

Emily H.: Scheduling note: because of the late request, Id like us to hold merge until Fri 14:00 UTC rollback window in case customers rely on old slug. Can we label accordingly? Also add docs/needs-2-approvals and docs/hold-until:2026-03-27-14:00.

Priya R.: Sounds good. Assigning reviewers now: Felix T. (auth content), Nora L. (CLI/links), Sam K. (formatting). Author is unavailable, so reviewers may push small fixes. Ill merge after two approvals and green CI and only in the Fri window Emily suggested.

docs-bot: CI: Build passed for PR #358. Preview URL: https://docs-preview.redwood.com/pr/358/build/13

Felix T.: All approvals added. I left a small follow-up commit to make the output explicit.

Nora L.: Reviewing follow-up  looks good. Approving now.

Sam K.: Approved (formatting only).

Priya R.: Two approvals + green CI. Holding merge until Fri 14:00 UTC as requested. I'll schedule the merge and add a short changelog note about the slug redirect. /assign @Priya R.

Emily H.: Thanks team. If anything changes before Fri, ping me. Otherwise well merge in the window. :white_check_mark:
